findings.current: Martial artists who had mastered their movement techniques to the highest level could use arts like this.
findings.defect: The established Peak realm is replaced with the generic and potentially absolute “highest level,” obscuring the hierarchy that the following comparison with Supreme Peak masters establishes.
findings.rationale: 절정 is the established Peak realm, and the passage distinguishes techniques available at that level from Stepping on Empty Air, which requires a Supreme Peak master.
findings.replacement: Martial artists who had mastered their movement techniques to the Peak realm could perform feats like this.
findings.source: 신법을 절정으로 익힌 무인들은 이와 같은 기예를 사용할 수 있었는데, 눈밭을 달리면서도 흔적이 남지 않는 답설무흔(踏雪無痕)과 물 위를 평지처럼 걸어갈 수 있다는 등평도수(登萍渡水)도 비슷한 맥락이다.

findings.current: *Of course, if I really put my mind to it, I could probably use Flying Over Grass too.*
findings.defect: “Probably” turns Taekyung’s qualified but definite statement of capability into uncertainty.
findings.rationale: 못 할 건 없다 states that he can do it if he chooses; it does not express doubt about whether he is capable.
findings.replacement: *Of course, Flying Over Grass isn’t beyond me either if I put my mind to it.*
findings.source: ‘물론 초상비 정도는 나도 마음만 먹으면 못 할 건 없기는 한데.’

findings.current: > - A Chain Quest, **A Long Journey in Search of an Elixir**, has been generated.
findings.defect: The localized quest title omits the explicit thirty-thousand-li numeric hyperbole.
findings.rationale: 삼만리 specifically means thirty thousand li; reducing it to “a long journey” removes the title’s concrete exaggeration.
findings.replacement: > - A Chain Quest, **Thirty Thousand Li in Search of an Elixir**, has been generated.

findings.current: > - Chain Quest, **A Long Journey in Search of an Elixir**, successfully completed!
findings.defect: The second occurrence of the quest title likewise omits the explicit thirty-thousand-li hyperbole.
findings.rationale: The completed quest must retain the same title used when it was generated, including 삼만리.
findings.replacement: > - Chain Quest, **Thirty Thousand Li in Search of an Elixir**, successfully completed!
findings.source: - 연계 퀘스트, [영약 찾아 삼만리]를 성공적으로 완료했습니다!

findings.current: The two Master and Disciple stared blankly at me before reaching out at the same time and accepting the object I offered them.
findings.defect: “The two Master and Disciple” is ungrammatical and treats the relationship labels as a malformed collective noun.
findings.rationale: The parenthetical characters 師弟 identify the pair as master and disciple; the replacement preserves both that relationship and their simultaneous action.
findings.replacement: Master and Disciple alike stared blankly at me, then reached out at the same time to take the object I held out.
findings.source: 멀뚱멀뚱 나를 바라보던 두 사제(師弟)는 동시에 손을 내밀어 내가 내민 물건을 받아든다.

findings.defect: “More than” adds a degree of excess not stated in the source.
findings.rationale: 충분하오 means that the ginseng is sufficient; the force of the moment comes from his vigorous nod and exclamation, not from an added claim that it exceeds the requirement.

findings.current: Thinking of how she had given it to me as a gift while lying that it was Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng in case I found the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng burdensome and refused it, I let out a quiet laugh.
findings.defect: The sentence awkwardly makes the ginseng itself sound “burdensome” and flattens 실소 into a generic quiet laugh.
findings.rationale: 내가 부담스러워 describes Taekyung feeling burdened by such a valuable gift, while 실소 is a wry or incredulous chuckle rather than merely a quiet one.
findings.replacement: I let out a wry chuckle as I thought of how she had given it to me while passing the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng off as Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng, worried I might feel burdened and refuse it otherwise.
findings.source: 혹시 내가 부담스러워 거절할까 봐 천년설삼을 백년설삼으로 속이면서까지 선물해 준 그녀를 생각하자 실소가 새어 나왔다.

findings.current: A small figure moved swiftly beside us.
findings.defect: The plural “us” changes the narrator-relative position, and “beside” drops the emphasis of 바로.
findings.rationale: 바로 옆 is “right beside” the first-person narrator in this context, not generically beside the whole group.
findings.replacement: A small figure sped along right beside me.
findings.source: 바로 옆, 자그마한 신형이 빠르게 나아간다.

summary: Two hierarchy and capability statements are weakened, the quest title loses its numeric hyperbole, and several localized fidelity or wording issues remain.
